games.title: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake
games.description:
Join the enchanting world of Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake, an engaging game that combines puzzle-solving with café management. Explore a beautiful mansion, uncover family secrets, and help Emily grow her café into a culinary empire. Enjoy this unique experience for free on your phone or computer.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, drag items.
Mobile: Tap buttons, drag items with your finger.

Key Features:
• Expand your cooking table! : Combine ingredients and find matches on the table. Merge and expand your territory! This way, you can cook more masterpieces!
• Combine ingredients! : Want to create something more complex than a sandwich? Great! Combine ingredients to unlock increasingly complex dishes.
• Restore the café! : Restore the café and other areas with the money you earn. An incredibly engaging process where you’ll see progress at every stage!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 21 maps
• Café. : Your grandfather's café has fallen into disrepair. Why be sad when you can restore it and make it better than before? Get to work!
• Café facade. : You've done well inside the café, great! But the facade also needs repairs, it's time to work on that too!

Story / Setting:
You've come to your grandfather's café in the countryside. Unfortunately, it has long been abandoned. Once a popular spot, it's now your task to restore it and make it even better!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Revive your grandfather's café and breathe new life into its walls! Cook delicacies for visitors and develop your kitchen by unlocking new dishes!

Q: Is there a story?
A: You lived in a big city, but you had to return. Your grandfather had an old café, but sadly, it has fallen into disrepair. Help restore it and make it better than before! You will encounter new characters—delight them with your tasty treats!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: Pleasant graphics, everything looks cozy and warm. It's especially satisfying to watch the progress of the café's reconstruction. With each amount earned, you can repair and upgrade your café and move on to other locations! With each new stage, you will see progress.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features a total of 21 locations! You will restore them one by one, cooking food and drinks. Each location is unique with its own distinct style and theme.

Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Combine ingredients to get new ones. Expand your cooking table to hold more ingredients. Upgrade your kitchen tools to cook more efficiently!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?
A: As you play, you will expand your table, allowing you to accommodate more ingredients for cooking. You will also upgrade your kitchen setup, receiving new equipment. But you won't be limited to just the kitchen. New locations will unlock as you progress through the game!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?
A: Upgrade the café and other locations. And don't forget about kitchen tools. With them, you can cook more delicious food!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: You start with an abandoned coffee shop and gradually, step by step, restore it. It's very engaging to watch life return to a once-popular place!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play anywhere and even without sound if that suits you better.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first missions, the game will show you what to do and how to do it. Additionally, hints will guide you in moments where you might miss something. But don’t worry, you’ll understand everything quickly!

You are the author of your own story. Create tales and bring them to life in the game!

Q: Is there a storyline?

A: You will understand everything from the first minutes in the game. The game will show you all the basic mechanics, and you'll quickly get the hang of it!

games.title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
games.description:
ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang is a casual food game where you are the star of a mukbang stream. You get to enjoy delicious dishes, interact with your audience, and grow your popularity with every bite, all on camera! Each meal takes you closer to becoming even more popular, so keep eating, keep engaging, and watch your virtual foodie journey unfold.
How to Play ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
Relaxing, fun, and super engaging, ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang lets you enjoy cooking, eating, and styling in a way that’s not only entertaining but also rewarding. Keep streaming, earning, and upgrading to become the most popular mukbang star! Become a livestream star with your channel, serving up drinks, dishes, and endless ASMR satisfaction. There are a few livestreams that you’ll participate in to get as many likes and hearts as possible from your fans.
Curate Your Stream
Start with a drink, pick your glass from thin-rimmed, stemmed, and rounded, and then add ice cubes in shapes from classic squares to cute bears. Garnish with fruits like lime, kiwi, or raspberry (some unlock as you earn rewards). Choose your syrup, give it a shake, add a straw, and get ready to sip your way into livestream fame. But beware — a boring drink could mean negative feedback!
Dig In on Camera
Once the drinks are done, move on to food. Eat tempura, sundaes, ramen, chicken, lobster, and even mix them in one stream for bigger rewards. The more fun and satisfying the experience, the more your audience grows. Once your food is ready, it’s time to go live! Eat, chat, and interact with your viewers as you enjoy the food. Your realistic ASMR sounds will make the experience feel so satisfying that your viewers won’t want to miss a moment. Engage with fans and watch your audience grow!
Go to the Supermarket
Start by shopping for ingredients, then move on to cooking mouth-watering dishes! From spicy noodles to delicious seafood and even sweet treats, the possibilities are endless. Prepare a meal that will make your audience hungry for more! For some of your livestreams, you get to shop for snacks and treats like sushi, dumplings, candy, and ice cream, but don’t get brain freeze! Pay with your card, stock up, and get ready to stream again.
Cook, Stream, and Engage
Shop for ingredients, cook delicious meals, then go live. Eat, chat, and interact while your realistic ASMR sounds keep viewers hooked. Successful streams bring in money. Spend it on stylish outfits for your character, or unlock even more mouth-watering food to keep your audience entertained.
If you’re a livestream fan, this game can get quite addictive. The more successful your streams, the more money you make. Use your earnings to upgrade your girl’s outfits, giving her a stylish and trendy appearance. You can also buy even more delicious food to satisfy your growing audience and keep the mukbang going!


Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, move the mouse to rotate.
Mobile: Tap on buttons, swipe your finger to rotate.

Key Features:
• Plenty of Food: Discover a wide variety of dishes to suit every taste! Try them all and showcase them to your audience!
• Interactive: Visit restaurants for delicious treats or head to the supermarket to pick out your favorite dishes. Scan items at the checkout and pay with your card! And that's not all. You can even prepare some delicacies yourself! Skewer fruits and berries and coat them in caramel glaze. A perfect dessert for your mukbang!
• Decorate Your Home: Choose furniture, flooring, walls, and other details for your home! Mukbangs need to be filmed in a cozy setting!

Game Modes:
• Dining: Head to a café and select delicacies for your mukbang!
• Minimart: Go shopping at the supermarket! Pick something tasty and showcase it on your stream!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: You play as a mukbang streamer! Eat delicacies live on stream, gain new subscribers and likes, enjoy new tasty treats, and build your popularity with your audience!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: A plethora of delicious options! You’ll find a variety of tasty dishes here, from sweets and drinks to hot fish or meat dishes. Takoyaki, onigiri, caramel-coated berries, and much more—there will definitely be plenty to eat on your stream and show to your viewers!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game flows seamlessly. Days pass one after another, and with each new day, your subscribers will grow, and you'll earn more money!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new foods and modes. Surprise your viewers with new dishes, and of course, try them out yourself!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?
A: Purchase new food at the store, but you can also visit restaurants to choose treats there! You can even make drinks and some desserts yourself!

Q: Are there skins/customization options?
A: Your viewers will love to see you in new outfits. Choose a costume from the skin shop and stream your mukbang in style! You can also change not just your character's skin but also the table or walls in your room! Diversify your background!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Right from the start, you will make drinks for your first mukbang! Pour a cocktail of your choice, add selected ingredients, mix well, and see what you’ve created!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily tasks / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: Yes! Spin the wheel of fortune and win prizes! You won’t be disappointed. You’re sure to get something worthwhile!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play as you like. But with sound, you’ll immerse yourself better in the cozy atmosphere of the game!

Q: What achievements are there and how can you earn them?
A: Stream and post updates, collect clips from your mukbangs, and cherish the wonderful moments!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: The game is intuitive from the first seconds. It will guide you through all the mechanics and show you how to play without unnecessary text.

Your progress saves automatically, and once the restaurant is automated it keeps earning while you're away.

games.title: Kendel 7 Days 7 Styles
games.description: In 7 Days 7 Styles, you’re dressing for fun: from sunrise to sunset, there’s looks to be spun; beach day or brunch, gym or the mall, style it your way and wow them all!

games.title: Mom Life Simulator Baby Care
games.description:
Mom Life Simulator Baby Care Games lets you experience the daily life of a caring virtual mom in a fun and realistic family simulation. Complete exciting household tasks, prepare meals, clean the house, take care of your kids, shop for groceries, and spend quality time with your happy family. Every level brings new challenges and rewarding activities that make family life fun and engaging.

Explore multiple game modes and a wide variety of missions, including cooking, home management, parenting, shopping, pet care, family outings, and special events. Enjoy smooth controls, colourful 3D environments, realistic animations, and immersive sound effects as you progress through dozens of exciting levels.

Features
-Multiple game modes with unique family life challenges
-Dozens of fun levels and household missions
-Cook meals, clean, shop, and manage your home
-Take care of children and complete parenting tasks
-Beautiful 3D environments and smooth gameplay
-Easy controls with realistic family life simulation
-Fun activities, family outings, and daily routine missions
-Suitable for players who enjoy simulation and family games

Become the perfect virtual mom and experience the joys and responsibilities of family life in this entertaining anime mother simulator.

games.title: Bingo Mania
games.description:
A casual bingo progression game. Complete Kitchen Quest levels to gather ingredients, cook recipes from cupcakes to a grand feast, and unlock Bingo Battles at level 25 where you can play against other players in the game!

In Kitchen Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — numbers are called, you daub matching cells, and complete patterns (lines, corners, themed shapes) to win. Every victory earns ingredients and recipe progress through stages: gather, prep, cook, decorate, and serve.

Cook your way through five kitchen tiers: cupcake, pizza, burger, cake, and a grand feast. Serve your first dish in just 5 levels, then tackle longer recipes as difficulty ramps up with more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles.

At level 25, unlock Bingo Battles — timed head-to-head duels against rival chefs. Outscore them before time runs out in ranked Trophy Duels or casual practice matches. There’s also a Chef Battles ladder gauntlet, daily tasks, leagues, and seasonal rewards.

Portrait-first mobile design makes it easy to play on the go.

games.title: Burger Life
games.description: Burger Life is a fun simulation game where you have to manage your own burger restaurant. Start by buying the essential equipment, serve your clients, hire employees and grow your business. Complete all tasks and make the best decisions to achieve your highest goals. Expand your burger restaurant to the max and have fun while doing it!

games.title: Cook Soups: 3 in a Bowl
games.description:
✨ What awaits you:
🥘 125 real recipes — borscht, shchi, fish soup, solyanka, kharcho, tom yum and dozens of other soups from around the world. All recipes are real!
📖 Discover new dishes — complete levels and fill up your recipe book. How many soups can you cook?
🏆 Compete with others — climb the leaderboard by the number of soups cooked and become the best chef!
👨‍🍳 Change your look — choose avatars, backgrounds and beautiful pots to your taste.
No rush, no stress — just the warm atmosphere of a home kitchen. Brew some tea, relax and cook the perfect soup!

games.title: Home Design - Match 3
games.description: Dive into a fun blend of creativity and strategy with Home Design - Match 3. Solve puzzles, design your ideal home, and unleash powerful boosters. Tackle challenging tasks and earn rewards to enhance your decor. Get ready to personalize your living spaces on any device!

games.title: Monster Makeup 3D
games.description: Dive into the exciting realm of Monster Makeup 3D, where you can creatively disguise monsters as humans to hide them from prying eyes. Use various tools to change their features seamlessly, but be cautious—one mistake could backfire! Enjoy this free online game on any device.

games.title: Nail Salon
games.description: Nail Salon is a creative and fun nail beauty art experience where you transform clients’ nails into dazzling works of beauty. Step into a vibrant salon, welcome your customers, and unleash your artistic skills to create stunning makeovers. Express your creativity with endless designs and colors, making each client’s nails truly shine. 💅✨

games.title: Delete part in LoveStory
games.description:
In this dop 2 game, you'll witness a glimpse into the character's life and destiny.
Reflect on the missing elements and incorporate them in a single line!
When your brain out expectations are fulfilled, their dissatisfaction will fade, and a smile will grace your face!

games.title: Anime Avatar Maker: Anime Doll
games.description:
Game features:
✨ Choose different skin tones, hair styles, hair colors, eyes expressions and stylish dresses with lots of decoration items.
✨ Various hairstyles, different themes, and dressing up anime characters!
✨ Beautiful graphic art and high quality sound, well-arranged anime background scenes, a different photo experience!
✨ 2 different modes: Doll maker and PK

games.title: Little Princess Dress Up
games.description:
Why You'll Love Little Princess Dress Up:

✨ Fashion Battles with Other Players: Showcase your style skills by battling it out with other players. May the best fashion creator win!

✨ Capture Your Creations: Take pictures of your dressed-up dolls and save them to your gallery. Share your designs with friends or keep them as your fashion portfolio.

✨ Special Princess Dresses: Access a collection of special dresses, including princess gowns that will make your doll look like royalty.

✨ Adorable Chibi Graphics: Dive into a game with cute and adorable graphics that will melt your heart with every outfit you create.

✨ Healing Sounds: Enjoy the healing soundtracks that make your dress-up experience even more relaxing and enjoyable.

✨ Be a Doll Avatar Maker: Create your favorite character with a wide range of customization options, bringing your ideal chibi doll to life.

games.title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
games.description:
🎀 Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY takes you into a magical world of creativity and fashion! In this charming paper doll game, you’ll help Anna dress up for a variety of occasions, from costume parties and romantic dates to festive holidays like Halloween and Christmas.

👗 Endless Outfit Choices

Explore a wardrobe full of stunning clothes and accessories tailored to each event. Whether it’s a spooky Halloween costume or a dazzling Christmas outfit, you’ll find the perfect look for Anna.

✨ Fairy Tale Vibes

With its adorable art style and enchanting themes, this game makes every moment feel like you’re styling a fairy princess. Every outfit you create adds a touch of magic to Anna’s story.

games.title: Sort And Style: Back To School
games.description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

games.title: Yummy Shelf
games.description: Yummy Shelf is a relaxing 3D sorting and matching puzzle game. Organize colorful food items, match three identical products, and clear every shelf before time runs out. Use helpful boosters to overcome tricky layouts and complete increasingly challenging levels.

games.title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
games.description: Get ready for a spooky and stylish adventure in Iconic Halloween Costumes! Help three BFFs pick out their perfect Halloween looks, from royal Glinda and Bridgerton-inspired outfits to edgy Beetlejuice vibes and cowgirl-chic styles. Customize their costumes with tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to create iconic Halloween outfits. Play now and let the fashion fun begin!

games.title: Food Tower Defense
games.description: 🍔 Welcome to Food Tower Defense – The Tastiest Tower Defense Ever! 🍕🍟 Prepare your appetite and sharpen your strategy because Food Tower Defense is here to serve you the most delicious tower defense experience ever! 🍴😋 In this mouth-watering adventure, your mission is simple but savory: defend your kitchen kingdom 🍽️ from waves of hungry invaders determined to steal your scrumptious stash of food! As the head chef and master tactician 👨‍🍳🧠, it’s your job to build, upgrade, and strategically position an army of powerful food towers — each with its own unique flavor and attack style! From explosive burgers to slippery bananas, every tower brings something special to the table. 🍔🍌💥 🎯 Your Mission: Protect the Feast! The hungry hordes are coming! 😱 Waves of greedy food thieves, ravenous creatures, and snack-hungry monsters are marching toward your kitchen. You’ll need to plan your defenses carefully, combining different food towers to maximize power and coverage. Experiment with combos 🍕+🍟+🍗 to find your perfect recipe for victory! Great for when enemies surround you! 🧀 Nachos Spread – Unleash a V-shot of nachos 🔺🧀 for rapid mid-range coverage. Cheesy and deadly! 🍅 Ketchup Laser – Continuous ketchup beam that burns enemies with spicy precision 🔴💫. 🍌 Banana Slip – Toss banana peels to make enemies slip, slow down, and even crash into each other 😆🍌. 🏰 Classic Mode: Defend your base from endless waves of food raiders! 💡 Strategy Meets Flavor Mix and match towers to discover powerful combo effects — like BBQ + Fries = Sizzling Combo Bonus! 🔥🍟 Upgrade your towers, unlock rare recipes, and customize your defense style. Whether you prefer long-range sniping or all-out sauce mayhem, there’s a perfect build for every chef-defender! 👩‍🍳⚔️ 🎨 Visuals & Atmosphere Enjoy colorful, cartoon-style graphics 🍭, smooth animations, and deliciously detailed food towers that look good enough to eat (but don’t, please 😅). Every battle is a feast for your eyes — from gooey cheese explosions 🧀💥 to rivers of ketchup lasers 🍅⚡. Earn coins 💰, gather ingredients 🥕, and upgrade your towers to unlock legendary recipes and secret sauces! 🎮 Why You’ll Love Food Tower Defense ✔️ Addictive tower defense gameplay with a tasty twist 🍕 ✔️ Over 10 unique food towers, each with upgrade paths and combos ✔️ Vibrant, food-filled worlds and creative enemy designs 🍩👾 ✔️ Fun sound effects and sizzling action! 🔊 Ready to defend your kitchen from the hungry hordes? 👊🍔 Build your defenses, cook up chaos, and serve defeat to your enemies in Food Tower Defense — the most flavorful tower defense game ever made! 🌶️🎮

games.title: My Pet Care Salon: Obby Dress-Up 3D
games.description:
Welcome to a cute pet care salon!
In this casual simulation game, you run your own animal care salon. Wash your pets, take care of them, decorate them, and train them so they become happier and healthier.

Complete simple tasks, upgrade your salon, and unlock new features. Every pet needs attention and care. The game offers relaxing gameplay, a cozy atmosphere, and lots of adorable moments with lovely pets.

Perfect for players who love animals and calm casual games.

games.title: Dream Home
games.description:
A cozy 3D builder where you design and furnish your very own house from scratch. Raise walls and floors, paint them any color, hang wallpaper, lay flooring, arrange furniture, and decorate the yard: from flower beds and a campfire to a pool and a fountain.

Finished a room? Step inside! First-person walk mode lets you stroll through your house, climb the stairs, and see the result with your own eyes, by day and by night.

Want more than a sandbox? Fill client orders: build to the brief, get graded on your work, earn experience, and level up. A special challenge order is available every day. As you level up, new plots unlock — so you can work on several houses at once.

games.title: Christmas Girls Dress Up
games.description: Celebrate the holidays in Christmas Girls Dress Up, a festive fashion game where you style four friends for a magical Christmas celebration! Each girl has a unique theme: gingerbread cutie, Nutcracker elegance, Santa sweetheart, and Grinch-inspired glam. Mix and match tops, dresses, hairstyles, shoes, and accessories to create cozy, cheerful outfits. Create unique Christmas outfits for our girls, express your creativity, and enjoy the ultimate Christmas dress-up fun filled with sparkle, style, and holiday vibes!

games.title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
games.description: Get spooky and stylish with K-Pop Halloween Dress Up! Dress the Huntrix girls in hauntingly chic outfits like Witch, Pumpkin Queen, Vampire Idol, and more. Mix costumes, accessories, and spooky face paint to create bold Halloween looks for your favorite idols. Show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween K-pop style in this fun dress up game!

games.title: Kind Shelter - Animal Care and Treatment
games.description:
A relaxing ASMR animal-care game where you treat and style adorable pets. 

As a caring vet and stylist, you’ll examine and heal stray cats and other furry friends, bathe and groom them, remove parasites, and perform delicate treatments. 
After care, dress them up with cute outfits, accessories, and hairstyles. 

Enjoy soothing sounds, cozy vibes, and the harmony of every touch!

games.title: Ancient Dragons Princess
games.description: Enter the magical realm of the Dragon Princess, Rennie, where elegance is paramount. Adorn her in lavish outfits, from velvet gowns to outfits suited for dragon riding. Customize a unique dragon for her, style her hair, add exquisite jewelry, and join Rennie on an extraordinary journey.

games.title: Animal Care Tycoon
games.description:
Welcome to Animal Care Tycoon 🐾🏥, where the city depends on you and adorable animals need your care 💖

Build and manage your own idle animal hospital, starting from a small treatment room and turning it into the biggest veterinary center in the city 🏙️💰 Heal fluffy patients, earn coins, unlock powerful medicine, and upgrade modern equipment to save animals faster and better ⚕️✨

Become the ultimate pet doctor 🐶🐱 Treat cats, dogs, sheep, and even exotic animals like zebras 🦓 Every patient arrives with a unique problem such as colds, viruses, fractures, and more 🤒🦴 Unlock advanced tools, discover new treatments, and make sure every animal gets the love it deserves 💊❤️

Hire professional vet doctors and skilled staff to keep your hospital running smoothly 👩‍⚕️👨‍⚕️ The more rooms you unlock, the more animals you can help, and the more gold you earn 🪙🚀 Managing a growing animal hospital is a real challenge, but true animal lovers will enjoy every moment 🐾

Animal Care Tycoon is the perfect game for players who love animals and management games 🐕🎮 If you dream of running your own pet clinic, healing animals, and building a successful hospital empire, this journey is made for you 🌟

games.title: Dreamy Home
games.description:
It's not just a game, but a warm and peaceful adventure that helps you feel the magic of ordinary moments. 🌸

Opening box after box, you will find personal items and lovingly find the perfect place for them. Room by room, step by step, you will assemble mosaics of memories and emotional stories hidden in simple objects.

There's no need to rush - enjoy the process: create cosiness, decorate, arrange and let the space tell its story without words. It's a calming activity where there is no rush, only calm and contentment. 🍃

From small little things to treasured heirlooms, every object carries a piece of life. As you immerse yourself in the game, you'll reminisce, dream and smile as you unpack an entire life step by step.

Immerse yourself in a cosy world where soft visual details, relaxing sounds and thoughtful gameplay create an atmosphere of warmth and nostalgia. ✨

games.title: Paws And Pals Diner
games.description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

games.title: Kinder Garden
games.description:
Imagine yourself as a kindergarten teacher. Change diapers, feed and put the little ones to bed.
Only you can create an atmosphere of warmth, care and love that will make the kindergarten an ideal place for the growth and development of children.
Are you ready to become a teacher?

games.title: Pop Culture Halloween Makeup
games.description: Immerse yourself in the world of Pop Culture Halloween Makeup, where you can transform into your favorite pop culture icons. With a wide array of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, blush options, neck paint, tops, and accessories, you can create stunning Halloween makeup looks that will leave everyone in awe. Unleash your imagination, experiment with different styles, and become the ultimate makeup artist. Tap into the spirit of Halloween and play Pop Culture Halloween Makeup now to embark on a spooktacular journey!

games.title: Dessert Maker
games.description: Dessert Maker is a fun-filled dessert creation game where you can craft the sweetest treats! Make creamy ice cream, colorful popsicles, fluffy waffles, refreshing bingsu, and even rolled ice cream. Mix flavors, experiment with toppings, and design your perfect masterpiece. Unleash your creativity and become a true dessert artist!

games.title: Swimming Pool Romance
games.description: Lucas is looking for a girl, obviously, at the swimming pool. And he find one, Natasha. She's so cute, he can't resist. Help him attract her with his mojo so they can spend a romantic evening together!

games.title: Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design
games.description:
«Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design» is a bright dress-up and interior design game where everyone can show creativity. Six popular heroes are waiting for you: Cappuccino Assassino, Ballerina Cappuccina, Bombardiro Crocodilo, Orcalero, Chimpanzini Bananini and Tralalelo Tralalata. Each character is unique, and you can create their own style: choose outfits, hats and accessories, mix looks and invent fashionable combinations.

Then move on to interior design! Decorate rooms with furniture, hang paintings, add cozy details and create spaces to your taste. There are no limits or restrictions — only your imagination and freedom of expression.

If you enjoy creative games like Toca Boca, where you can dress up characters and design rooms, «Brainrots: Dress Up & Interior Design» is the perfect choice. Experiment, create stories and bring your ideas to life!

games.title: Mansion Design - Match 3
games.description:
Decorate and renovate the mansion and garden by beating match-3 blast levels! Makeover each room with a large selection of classical furnitures and exquisite decorations, including your personal bathroom and garden.

Features:
● Follow the storyline and discover all the hidden secrets in your mansion!
● Fun and challenging match-3 levels with unique boosters and explosive combinations! 
● Help young lady cast magic spell by swapping and matching pieces!
● Renovate the mansion and design the interior, keep your home under control.

games.title: My Bakery
games.description:
Build your confectionery empire in Family Bakery. Bake delicious treats, serve guests, and decorate your café in this cozy simulator designed for everyone.
Have you ever dreamed of running your own café? This bakery game gives you the opportunity. Your task is to bake pastries and satisfy customers to grow your business.
Why You Should Play
Simple and Engaging Mechanics: Customers arrive, you bake pastries, and serve them quickly.
Pleasant Atmosphere: A vibrant and warm design creates a relaxing mood.
Constant Progression: Unlock new recipes and expand your dining area.
Perfect for Relaxation: Easy-to-learn gameplay makes it a great game to unwind and relieve stress.

games.title: JUICE TYCOON
games.description:
A relaxing and addictive arcade-idle game where you build your own juice empire! Harvest fresh fruits, blend them
 into delicious drinks, and serve thirsty customers. Hire staff, upgrade your machines, and expand your business
 until you become the ultimate Juice Tycoon!

games.title: Princess Dental: Dentist Games
games.description: Welcome to the city dental clinic, where princesses come for their smiles! Help adorable princess patients take care of their teeth and solve different dental problems. 🪥 Examine their teeth, clean plaque, treat cavities, and use various dentist tools to make their smiles healthy and beautiful again. Each princess has a different dental problem, making every treatment a new challenge. ✨ Take good care of your patients and become their favorite dentist!

games.title: Duck Family Simulator Animal Games
games.description:
Experience the exciting life of a wild duck in Duck Family Simulator Animal Games! Explore beautiful islands, peaceful lakes, and lush green forests while raising your duck family and surviving against dangerous predators. Hunt for food, protect your ducklings, complete thrilling missions, and discover the adventures of life in the wild.
Fly freely across the island, explore hidden locations, collect coins, and unlock new adventures as you progress through the game. Customize your duck, improve your survival skills, and experience realistic wildlife gameplay in a vibrant 3D open world.

Features
-Raise and protect your own duck family.
-Explore beautiful islands, forests, lakes, and open-world environments.
-Hunt for fish, insects, and other food to survive.
-Battle dangerous predators including crocodiles, snakes, sharks, giant lizards, and wild dogs.
-Fly through the skies, collect coins, and discover hidden areas.
-Build a safe home and care for your ducklings.
-Complete exciting survival missions and wildlife challenges.
-Smooth controls, realistic animations, and immersive 3D gameplay.

Become the leader of your duck family and experience a fun wildlife adventure filled with exploration, survival, family-building, and action in Duck Family Simulator Animal Games. Explore the wilderness, protect your loved ones, and prove your survival skills in this exciting animal simulator.

games.title: Dream Home: Merge Story
games.description:
Dream Home: Merge Story is a cozy game about merging items and renovating a home. Combine identical items on the board, unlock higher-level items, and complete orders.

Completing tasks rewards you with stars. Spend them on renovations, furniture, and new interior elements as you gradually turn an old house into a beautiful and cozy home.

Keep an eye on your energy, plan your moves, and make sure there is enough free space on the board. Crystals can help you restore energy faster, while additional rewards let you keep playing.

Complete tasks, discover new items, and watch your new home transform room by room.

games.title: Snack Sort
games.description:
Master the vending machine puzzle challenge!
Clear colorful vending machines by sorting snacks into matching groups. With hundreds of satisfying levels, Snack Sort combines simple tap mechanics with brain-teasing puzzle strategy. Can you organize the chaos and empty every shelf?

Features
✓ Hundreds of levels to master
✓ Colorful, appetizing snack graphics
✓ Simple one-tap controls
✓ Relaxing yet challenging puzzle gameplay
✓ Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle marathons
Can you sort them all?

games.title: Mavy The Fish Mom
games.description: Mavy is a devoted fish mom who takes care of her children by cooking food for them. It's an Idle farming game.

games.title: Black Friday Dress Up Selfie
games.description: Shop the best looks in Black Friday Dress Up Selfie! Help your fashionista choose outfits from her wishlist, cozy fall fits, warm winter layers, sparkly holiday glam, and dark-academia vibes. Mix tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, and accessories to create the perfect selfie-ready style. A fun, fast way to solve every “What should I wear?” moment!

games.title: Funny Angela Haircut
games.description: Give Angela the best hairstyle ever! Enjoy tons of professional tools like curling irons, blow dryers, scissors, magic hair growing spray, and so much more! Dye her hair in any variety of colors. Complete the makeover with stylish outfit, mix and match cute clothes and dress up Angela to become more fashionable!

games.title: Capy Cafe
games.description:
Capy Cafe is a cozy idle-management game where you run an adorable café as a hard-working capybara barista. Harvest fresh strawberries and tea leaves, brew fragrant teas, shake up bubble tea and boba, and blend creamy smoothies — then serve them to a steady stream of happy customers.

There are no buttons to fumble with: just waddle up to a station and your capy gets to work automatically. Reinvest your earnings to unlock new drinks and stations, and hire helper capybaras to keep every corner of the cafe humming while you expand. What starts as a tiny tea stand grows into a bustling boba empire — one cup at a time.

Simple one-thumb controls, satisfying progression, and the most relaxing café this side of the riverbank. Genre: casual idle tycoon / shop-management sim.

games.title: Fruit Chopper
games.description:
Grand fruit slasher is out!

Gameplay is zero hassle. Time your throws carefully and try to slash multiple fruits at once to get bonus score! Be nimble and accurate - DO NOT MISS!

You'll get one cocktail per every level completed. After you get 4 cocktails, you will get free spin of fortune wheel! RARE COCKTAILS = BETTER REWARDS!

Can you reach level 100?

games.title: Cooking Shawarma Idle Game
games.description:
We are providing a stunning and engaging gameplay experience that delivers a real simulation of running a shawarma business. From managing different shawarma and fast-food items to handling customers in real time, every moment feels like you are operating your own busy food stall. Upgrade your kitchen, speed up your service, and take your shawarma shop to the next level as you grow your culinary empire.

Your journey begins with a small shawarma stand, humble yet full of potential. As the Shawarma Restaurant Master, you will dive deep into the art of making perfect shawarma—from choosing the best meat cuts to marinating them with the ideal blend of spices. Every step matters, and every decision affects the final taste and customer satisfaction.

Enhance your slicing knife, lavash station, and cooking speed to boost profits and keep customers happy. Add ketchup, mayo, fries, pickles, and many other extras to customize each order based on customer demands.


Have you ever dreamed of cooking delicious dishes from around the world and exploring different cultures? All of that becomes possible in Our Shawarma Game!

games.title: Burger Game - Burger Shop
games.description:
⭐ Game Features ⭐
• Simple gameplay. Easy to get started!
• Satisfying art. Free music for your soul.
• Develop your HR skills by HIRE employees and UPGRADE their skills.
• Unlimited expansion!

Burger Shop IDLE is not just a clicker cooking game. It is also about making strategic decisions, optimizing your workflow, and satisfying your customers. games.title: Black Friday Mystery Sale
games.description: Dive into the excitement of Black Friday shopping with a twist! In the Black Friday Mystery Sale dress up game, fashion surprises await, and it's up to you to style the princesses with fabulous outfits hidden inside the mystery boxes. Ready for a shopping spree you’ll never forget? Start playing now!

games.title: Makeup Fruits
games.description:
Have you ever imagined giving a watermelon a makeover? How about adding a flutter of eyelashes or a swipe of lipstick to a juicy melon? In Makeup Fruits, your mission is to help these delightful fruits dazzle with beauty. It's all in your hands to adorn them with the perfect makeup and accessories for their stunning transformation!

games.title: BFF Easter Photobooth Party
games.description: Get the girls all set: it’s time to shine, dress them up in outfits so fine; strike a pose with flair and cheer for Easter fun and style are here!

games.title: Corner Bakery
games.description: Welcome to Corner Bakery, a cozy merge game about good food and the people next door. Combine matching pastries and drinks, fill your neighbors’ orders, and bring a neglected bakery and its neighborhood back to life. Meet seven characters, discover hidden keepsakes, and make dialogue choices across eight story chapters. Improve your kitchen, unlock recipes and explore six illustrated locations at your own pace.

games.title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
games.description: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is an Android game developed by Bravestars Games. This free game allows users to create stunning photos and fabulous videos featuring their own personalized dolls.

games.title: Girl Hair Salon & Dress Up
games.description:
In the game Hair and Beauty, you can experiment with the latest trends in hairdressing and fashion:

💇‍♀️ **Create stunning looks**
Offer your clients a variety of hairstyles, from trendy cuts to elegant updos.
🎨 **Express yourself with makeup**
Choose from a wide range of makeup products and styles to complete your clients' looks.
👗 **Dress to impress**
Select from hundreds of outfits and accessories to help your clients look their best.
💎 **Unlock new possibilities**
Earn rewards as you progress through the game and expand your salon's offerings.
📸 **Capture the moment**
Take photos of your clients before and after their transformations to share with your friends and the world!

games.title: Cooking Letters - Word Search
games.description:
- Start Your Culinary Adventure. When you enter the kitchen you will see a variety of tasty letters scattered across the game board. Each letter is an ingredient for creating words.  
- Find All the Hidden Words. Your goal is to find all the words from the list hidden on the game board. The faster you complete the task the more points you earn.

games.title: K-Pop Puzzle Hunters
games.description: In this free puzzle game, K-Pop fans and enthusiasts can piece together stunning images of Huntrix, Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger from the beloved K-Pop Demon Hunters universe. With puzzles ranging from 16 to 100 pieces, players can choose their challenge and utilize hints when needed. This game perfectly blends strategy, logic, and fandom fun, making it a great fit for anime lovers, fans of K-Pop, and puzzle enthusiasts. Start solving today to become the ultimate Puzzle Hunter.

games.title: Kuromi Maker
games.description: Design your very own Kuromi-style character with a vast array of customization options and a diverse color palette. With just one click, you can generate a randomly created hero—sometimes with hilarious results! If you''re not happy with the outcome, you can reset everything at any moment. Once you''re satisfied with your creation, save it as a PNG image.

games.title: Toco Teens Halloween Party
games.description:
Step into the spooky fun world of Toca Teens Halloween Party, a fashionable Halloween dress-up game made just for style lovers! 🎃
Join the Toca teens as they get ready for the most glamorous Halloween event of the year. Choose from eerie yet elegant outfits, haunting accessories, and bold makeup looks to create the perfect spooky-chic style.

Mix and match trendy costumes, experiment with hairstyles, and make each teen stand out on the dance floor. Whether you want a gothic witch, a cute pumpkin fairy, or a vampire diva — the possibilities are endless!

games.title: Easter Funny Makeup
games.description: Eliza and her niece are getting ready for Easter in the most creative way—by designing festive face art! Use cheerful symbols of the season like Easter eggs, bunnies, flowers, butterflies, and rainbows to craft a bright and joyful spring look.

games.title: Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks
games.description: Dive into the world of crafting drinks with the exciting **Bubble Tea Cocktail Maker Mix Drinks** game. Explore diverse ingredients to create unique cocktails. Enjoy the mixology experience on any device, unwind at your virtual bar, and become a master drink creator.

games.title: Cosplay Gamer Girls
games.description: Two BFF are going to a summer cosplay festival. They love computer games. Help the girls choose costumes for their favorite video game heroes and princesses. It is very important for a cosplayer to create a complete look: from makeup and hair to dress. Lots of original and gorgeous outfits are waiting for you!

games.title: BBQ Sort
games.description:
Welcome to the sizzling excitement of BBQ Sort Step up to the grill and show off your matching prowess in this delectable puzzle adventure.

Start with chill jazz and a few orders, but as you grow, expect huge, time-limited orders. Special requests will need your careful attention and unique cooking skills. Prepare for dynamic challenges and have fun!

games.title: Cake Ready
games.description: Cake Ready is a cozy merge-and-renovate puzzle game. Combine matching ingredients and kitchen tools to fulfill customer orders, earn rewards, and restore a lively cake cafe. Its satisfying item chains, story-driven renovation, and two connected play spaces make every merge part of building your dream bakery.

games.title: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion
games.description: Help Tom & Angela to become Instagram famous. Buy and choose clothes, hairstyles, or accessories by following their moods. Make them look stunning on every occasion, take beautiful pictures to post on Instagram and receive lots of likes. Get their insta-ready outfits and have fun!

games.title: Equal Cut
games.description:
Equal Cut is a one-swipe balancing puzzle: cut each piece of food into two exactly equal halves, then watch the scale prove how close you got. There's no timer and no live weight readout while you aim — just the shape in front of you and your own eye for where it balances.

25 foods, each an odd or irregular shape that hides its true balance point: a lopsided pretzel, a corn cob, a wedge of cheese, a whole pumpkin slice. Land a clean, even cut for up to three stars; miss and you get another attempt — there's always a free way to keep playing, never a wall.

games.title: Mike and Mia 1st Day School
games.description: Mike and Mia are very excited for their first day of school. Help them to clean their room and make a delicious snack box. Get dressed up with various cute clothes. Enjoy the first day at school with fun and loving playful activities!

games.title: Funny Pet Haircut
games.description: Take your messy pets, alpaca and cat to the hair salon. Wash and dry your pets before giving them a brand new look by changing their colors and giving them pattern look. Dress up too. And turn them into a stylish beauty!

games.title: DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater
games.description: Get ready to deck the halls with festive creativity in DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater! Join three BFFs as they design their unique ugly Christmas sweaters for an epic holiday party. Choose sweater colors and decorate them with Christmas trees, reindeer, snowmen, globes, lights, bows, and more! Complete their holiday looks with new hairstyles and festive accessories. Show off your holiday spirit and create the ultimate cozy, ugly sweater masterpiece in this fun and festive game!

games.title: Gothic New Era
games.description: A goth-girl arrives at the new Academy. She did not suspect that she would fall into a nightmare, the abode of chaos and mysterious riddles. She will definitely like it there. But before the trip, the gothic princess needs to update her wardrobe while staying true to style. Only dark, gloomy shades, gothic dresses and school uniforms. Join her and help the gothgirl create a unique image of the dark princess and find friends.

games.title: Eating Simulator The Italian Animals Brainrot
games.description:
Eating Simulator The Italian Animals Brainrot A fun physics puzzle game: feed hungry animals from Italian memes by using gravity, logic, and creativity!

Is a one-of-a-kind physics puzzle game where your mission is to feed adorable and funny animals inspired by Italian memes. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity: manipulate objects, control gravity, and build action chains to deliver food straight into the paws or beaks of quirky creatures. The game offers dozens of levels with increasing difficulty, hilarious scenarios, surprising solutions, and signature humor. Attention to detail and precision will be the key to success, while your reward will be the grateful looks of happy, well-fed animals. Dive into a world of carefree fun, where physics is your main tool for playful experiments, and every completed level brings fresh emotions. Test your skills and prove that you can feed every Brainrot animal!

games.title: Fruit Fusion
games.description:
Welcome to Fruit Fusion, the ultimate fruit-merging puzzle experience!
Drop and combine cherries, lemons, oranges, tomatoes, melons, coconuts, pumpkins, and watermelons to create bigger, juicier fruits. Keep merging to unlock massive combos and earn record-breaking points!

games.title: Miss Robins Dream Home
games.description:
Design beautiful homes in bright and sunny places and solve hundreds of fun match 3 puzzles in a light and fun match 3 home makeover game.

Meet Miss Robins, a young bright designer, and help design the decor and furniture to renovate beautiful houses.

- Hone your design skills by designing the home decor and furniture.
- Match candy and create power-ups
- Lot's of match-3 levels to enjoy
- Light and Fun Gameplay

games.title: Fruits into Baskets
games.description:
Just tap on the fruits, watch them fall into place, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything going where it belongs.
Your goal is to clear the whole field and sort all the fruits into the right baskets. No timer, no pressure — just you, the fruits, and that satisfying feeling of order after each level.
Perfect for short breaks when you need to unwind and breathe. Grab your phone, get comfortable, and sort fruits to your heart's content! 🍊🍋🍇

games.title: Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang
games.description:
Meet Kalulu — your new favorite mukbang streamer! Make delicious desserts, host ASMR streams, and win over your viewers' hearts!

🍓 Create crunchy Tanghulu
Skewer juicy berries, dip them in sugar syrup, and enjoy the perfect crunch! Experiment with strawberries, grapes, and other treats to create the most beautiful Tanghulu.

🧋 Make refreshing Boba Tea
Mix aromatic tea, add tapioca pearls, and create drinks that will delight your audience!

🎥 Host ASMR Mukbang streams
Go live and watch Kalulu eat the dishes you prepared! The relaxing eating sounds will help attract more viewers. Fulfill their requests and receive donations!

🎨 Customize everything around you
Create the perfect streaming space: choose wallpapers for the room, change the desk, and pick out stylish outfits for Kalulu. Make your studio look cozy and vibrant!

Join the relaxing world of mukbang with the cute Kalulu!

games.title: Tasty Out Arrow Puzzle
games.description:
Tasty Out! is a satisfying 2D logic puzzle game where your goal is to untangle delicious food-shaped arrow boards before your moves run out! Tap each directional arrow to clear the path, think ahead, and clear the screen step by step.  

KEY FEATURES:
* Deceptively Smart Puzzles: Over 150 handcrafted micro-levels shaped like sushi, burgers, and sweets.
* Move-Efficiency Bonus: Master every layout with minimum steps to earn bonus Gold and Trophies.
* Weekly Competitive League: Climb from Wood to Diamond against simulated player rankings.
* Exclusive Elite Vault: Spend your hard-earned Gold to tackle VIP stages and collect rare Food Badges.
* Endless Replayability: Unlock the infinite League mode once you conquer level 150.  
Can you untangle every delicious recipe and reach the Diamond League? 

Play Tasty Out! now!

games.title: Blondie in the Real World
games.description: Blondie lives in her perfect doll world. She is happy, but one day she realizes that something is wrong with her life. Her life is too artificial and perfect. Blondie decides to go to the real world to feel real. Help the Blonde to embody her image in makeup. Bake a cake for the guests and put things in order with Blondie in her new apartment. games.title: 11 Kisses

games.title: Yummy Hotdog

games.title: Lantern Alley: Match 3
games.description:
Match lines, charge your heroine, unlock the whole cast.

A lantern-lit night board with heroines on the tiles. Swap two neighbours, match three in a line, and the board collapses in a chain reaction. Four or five in a line leave a power-up that clears a row, a column or a square; double-tap it to set it off on its own — that costs a move, and there lies the choice.

Pick a heroine before each level. She charges only from her own tiles, so her colour decides how you play. Each has two abilities, the second unlocking with tenure.

160 levels, each with its own goal: score, colour, break crates or boulders, sometimes two at once. Five kinds of blockers: a boulder yields only to a direct hit, vine spreads while you ignore it, honey candies the board.

Stars earn sparks, sparks light the twelve lanterns along the path. One run will not light them all — come back and replay for the third star.

games.title: Magic Princess

games.title: Poofruits: Merge the Fruit
games.description:
Eleven fruits, from blueberry to watermelon, and every one of them has a face. They blink, squint when something lands on them, beam when they merge, and start to doze off if you leave them alone.

The physics is honest: a dropped fruit rolls, shoves its neighbours and can set off a chain of merges worth far more than you planned. Stacking well beats stacking fast.

games.title: Besties on Wednesday
games.description: A young bestie goes to school to learn magic and make new friends. She has her own special style. The girl prefers black colors in clothes and a gothic look. Her roommate likes bright colors in her clothes. It will not be easy for new acquaintances to find a common language. However, this bright girl is not as simple as it seems at first glance. She has her secrets. Try to choose for each student an image that suits her perfectly. And one day these besties will be BFF.

games.title: Good and Evil DressUp
games.description: Dive into the enchanting world of a sorceress at a magical academy in "Good and Evil DressUp." Experiment with striking outfits that blend good and evil, featuring everything from shiny leather to elegant satin. Enjoy this free online game on your phone or computer, unleashing your creativity in limitless fashion.

games.title: Fruit Lane Cafe
games.description: Fruit Lane Cafe is a colorful card-sorting puzzle game with a busy shop twist. Slide cards through lanes, line up matching sets, and complete your customers' orders before time runs out. Plan around the next card, manage the spare card, and unlock helpful boosters as the challenges grow. Simple tap controls, satisfying chain reactions, and a growing level map make every order a fresh puzzle.

games.title: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party
games.description: Indulge in the Fashionista Christmas Eve Party extravaganza! Discover glamorous holiday ensembles, festive accessories, and the perfect blend of chic for a stylish celebration. Join the fashion-forward festivities and elevate your Christmas Eve style to new heights. Unwrap the magic of the season with Fashionista, where every outfit is a statement and every moment is a fashion triumph. Let the glamour of Christmas Eve unfold.

games.title: Funny Hair Salon
games.description: George's hair is in a no bueno situation. His scalp is full of mites and pimps. The only way to fix his hair is going to the salon. Let's cure his scalp and plant new hair to his head, so he can show his true outter beauty!

games.title: Halloween Fruit Slice
games.description: Get ready for a thrilling slicing experience in Halloween Fruit Slice a spooky twist on the classic arcade game. With a Halloween-themed environment filled with eerie backgrounds, ghostly effects, and creepy music, this game combines fast-paced action with brain-teasing precision. Slice your way through a flurry of haunted fruits while avoiding the deadly traps that threaten your progress.

games.title: Pool Float Party
games.description: The best friends Blondie and Marie decided to have a pool party. What kind of party is there without cocktails? Let's make a refreshing mojito from soda, lemon, lime and mint leaves together. While Blondie is making cocktails, Marie is cleaning up the area next to the pool. Help the girls with creating a unique design for the party. Now that everything is ready, you can take care of yourself. Make up for each of the girls and choose the right outfit. Choose from a variety of swimsuits and pareos. Blondie prefers pink shades, while Marie loves the combination of red and black colors and the polka dot pattern. Don't forget to add stylish accessories to your look and choose an original-shaped inflatable raft for girls.

games.title: Fix Pizza: Food Sorting
games.description:
Enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle packed with pizza ingredients. Each pizza is covered with different food items: find the extra ingredients, collect them on matching plates, and restore the correct recipe. Look carefully, because the number of mistakes is limited.

Complete increasingly busy levels, discover new recipes, and sort pizzas filled with unusual ingredient combinations. As you progress, more items appear and the object search becomes more challenging. Use Highlight, clear mistakes, or Shuffle whenever you need help.

This is a relaxing game about sorting, observation, and finding objects, featuring juicy cartoon graphics, short levels, and simple controls. It works equally well for a quick break or a longer puzzle session at your own pace.

games.title: Funny Rescue Pet
games.description: Lica and Purry had an accident! Lica's house is on fire, and Purry is soak wet when she played inside the wall. How can it happen? Rescue them immediately and also give them some makeover!

games.title: Food Sort 3D

In this game, you manage your own food court, sorting various food items into their respective categories. You'll encounter different eateries, from fast-food joints to upscale restaurants, each requiring you to sort items like burgers,
sushi, hotdog, fries, pizza and desserts. The game features colorful graphics and quick, satisfying levels that keep you engaged as you expand your food

games.title: Dress Up Anime Girl
games.description: Anime DressUp is a fun online game that lets you style a cute anime princess. With a variety of outfits, hairstyles, and makeup, you can unleash your creativity and fashion skills. Enjoy creating unique looks and make your princess a standout fashionista in her realm!

games.title: Nubik Courier: An Open World
games.description: Nubik Courier: An Open World is an exciting delivery game that turns you into a skilled pizza courier racing through lively city streets. Navigate obstacles and switch vehicles as you complete each delivery, all while enjoying free online play. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it's perfect for casual gamers seeking thrills.

games.title: Hair Salon 3D
games.description:
Hair Salon 3D — a vibrant 3D hair salon simulator! Clients come to you with all kinds of requests: bob cuts, mohawks, undercuts, long layers, and much more. Pick up scissors, clippers, a razor, and a color brush — cut, style, and dye hair, trying to recreate the requested hairstyle as accurately as possible.

The better the result — the more stars and tips you earn! Collect in-game currency, buy new tools and dyes, unlock complex haircuts, and serve VIP clients. 23 unique hairstyles, 5 tools, a rating system, and daily challenges — you'll never get bored!

games.title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo Games

In Noob's shop you can always buy beet soup and bread! And also a lot of other food.

And now all the residents of CubeWorld rushed to the best store! Help Noob to serve all the customers! No one should go hungry! :)

It comes with 6 difficulties ranging from Beginner to Expert and there are more than 500 levels in total. Simply swipe letters from the word scramble to create a word. Connect the letters, find the words, and sharpen your word skills as you go.

games.description:
Open a family bakery and turn it into the city’s favorite spot. In the kitchen, merge matching ingredients and treats to create higher-level dishes. Serve customers, complete orders, and grow your reputation.

Tiny Delivery is an game, created by combining the ideas of food delivery and hill climbing.

Tangy and fruity or sweet and milky? The combinations are endless!

Master the art of hand pulled noodles in a skill based arcade cooking game where every successful pull doubles your strands.

Hold, watch the tension meter, and release in the green zone.
